data.one_liner: Widget that shows a moving animated gradient background for Flutter apps.
data.what_it_does: The package supplies an AnimatedGradient widget that paints a continuously shifting gradient. You can wrap any child widget to display it over the animated background.
use_when: You need a simple animated background without writing custom shaders
You want a quick visual effect that works on all Flutter platforms
avoid_when: Precise control over animation curves or gradient paths is required
Performance is critical for high‑frame‑rate scenes
Your project cannot use GPL‑3.0 licensed code
strengths: Works on Android, iOS, Web, Windows, macOS, Linux
No additional setup or native code needed
weaknesses: Only provides a random moving gradient
GPL‑3.0 license may be incompatible with some projects

alternatives.name: shimmer
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a lightweight shimmering effect that can be used as an alternative visual animation
